name: The Hidden Cavern
note: Suleiman's Hidden Cavern combat arena (roadmap Phase 11, his THE CAVE sheet): a sealed sandstone cavern lit only by fire. The ritual platform with its sigil stands in the middle at mid height, ringed by water; four wooden bridges cross to the walkways along the walls; high ledges sit in the corners. You can't climb from the water straight onto the platform (two levels up), so the bridges are the way in.
boardNote: size = columns and rows; tile sizes in the game's pixels. Bigger tiles than the first map give the characters more room (Suleiman 30 Oct).
cameraNote: follow: on a small screen the camera follows the unit whose turn it is, zoomed in; drag to look around, pinch or mouse wheel to see the whole board, or tap the little map top right.
heightsNote: Levels as in his height breakdown: 0 water, 1 low, 2 mid, 3 high. Row 0 is the far side, where the enemies start.
terrainNote: One letter per tile: F stone floor, S sand, R rubble, G the ritual platform's sigil stone, W shallow water (walkable; it leaves you Drenched), B a wooden bridge over the water.
sigilCircleNote: His sigil ring is drawn across the 3 by 3 platform around this tile.
lineUpNote: Roadmap 4.3 (Suleiman 29 Oct): Tayo swaps in for the bull, 3 against 3: Rabdul, Tayo and the archer. Units benched in units.json who fight here go in alsoFighting; units who sit this map out go in sittingOut. Four enemies were tried 1 Nov (the bull too): the heroes lost every test battle.
startsNote: Where each unit starts (column, row), by its id in units.json.
waterfallsNote: Water pouring off the platform: [column, row] of the ledge, then [column, row] of the water below. Only the faces turned towards the camera show.
lampsNote: Ritual lamps (decoration, and the light they give): on the platform's corner tiles and on the four high corners, each at the tile's outer corner.
surroundNote: The cavern round the board, as the camera sees it (so it stays behind the board when the camera turns): a ledge one tile deep at ledgeHeight with his props on it, then rock walls wallHeight levels high. at = [view column, view row]; -1 is the ledge. Props: stalagmiteTall, stalagmiteShort, rockPile, pillar, pots, brazier (lit), bones, rockPool.
digsitesNote: Things buried on the board (roadmap 5.3). A unit next to one (or on a dropped satchel) digs it up as its action and gets the item. A pot or bone pile blocks its tile until dug. prop: pots or bones; item: an id from items.json.
